service.title_tag: AI Receptionist: Answers Every Call 24/7, Done for You | ART3RY
service.meta_description: Art3ry's AI receptionist answers every call, books the job and texts you the lead. Flat monthly, scoped to your calls. Hear it on your own line, free.
service.h1:
An AI receptionist that answers every call,
books the job, and texts you the lead.
service.hero_sub: Art3ry is an AI receptionist for small business. It answers 24/7, asks the right questions, books appointments, and sends you a clean lead with the name, number and reason they called. Flat monthly, scoped to your call volume — no per-minute meter, no surprise fees.
service.what_lead: You stop living by the phone. The receptionist does.

steps.p: Every call, day and night, in a natural voice. No voicemail, no hold, no missed jobs.
Name, number, what they need, how soon. The fields worth capturing, every single time.
It books the job and sends the details to your phone as a text, so nothing goes cold.

scenarios.say: The phone never goes to voicemail again.
The caller becomes a booked job, not a lost lead.
The details reach you the second the call ends.
bullets: Follow-up that chases until it closes

faq.a: Flat monthly, scoped to your call volume. You get your exact number in a free 15-minute diagnostic — no per-minute meter, no surprise fees.

faq.q: Is it a real AI or a person?
faq.a: An AI that sounds like a person. It handles the routine calls and transfers to you the moment a caller needs a human.

faq.q: What if a caller needs me?
faq.a: It transfers, or takes a message you can act on. You set the rules.
Yes. The free diagnostic shows what it would catch on your own line before you pay anything.

service.cta_h2: Hear it answer your own line.
service.cta_p: Tell me how calls reach you and I'll show you the leaks, free.
